title: Numerical Elimination: Computing Complements of Real Hypersurfaces Using Pseudo-Witness Sets
summary: Many hypersurfaces in algebraic geometry, such as discriminants, arise as the projection of another variety. The real complement of such a hypersurface decomposes into connected components. In this paper, we propose a new method for computing these components. Existing methods require the explicit equation of the hypersurface as input. However, computing this equation by elimination can be computationally demanding or even infeasible.
